op:show.body:
Show it plainly.

Retrieval: no reshaping — return the measures over the requested grouping, nothing added.

Formatting: table by default; the grouping column first.

op:trend.body:
Change over time.

Retrieval: group by the finest time grain the question requests, and no finer. Order chronologically; require at least two periods.

Formatting: line chart by default, period column first.

Applicability: `time-grain` — without a grain this operator has nothing to group by and should surface a gap rather than guess one.

op:top-n.body:
The leaders.

Retrieval: order by the measure descending and cut at n; when n is unstated use 10 and SAY so.

Formatting: rank column first.

op:share-of.body:
Part against whole.

Retrieval: fetch the parts AND the whole in one result set; a share computed against a differently-filtered total is a wrong number that looks right.

Formatting: percentage column beside the absolute one.

op:compare.body:
Two things, side by side.

Retrieval: fetch both comparanda in ONE result set.

Formatting: side-by-side columns, then an absolute delta, then a percentage delta.

Applicability: `two-series` — exactly two comparanda; three or more is a breakdown, not a comparison.
